title: General coefficient restriction-pullback composition
statement: For any morphism a : Λ ⟶ Λ′ of commutative condensed rings, with the ordinary module pullbacks, scalar restrictions, and canonical comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], every pair of composable scheme maps f,g and target-coefficient module N satisfies the equality in lean.statement. Equivalently, upperStarComp followed by the two inverse restriction/pullback comparisons equals the comparison for f ≫ g followed by restriction of upperStarComp.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; coefficient-map and adjunction coherence in the general condensed-ring case

proof.text: Identify the inverse restriction/pullback comparison for each of f, g and f ≫ g as the mate of the restriction/pushforward comparison, using [new-comap-upper-star-iso-mate].

By faithfulness of module forgetful functors, restriction/pushforward comparisons respect composition: their underlying maps are identities and both pushforward composition maps are the same sheaf map.

Apply mateEquiv_hcomp and the two conjugate/mate whiskering identities from Mathlib. upperStarComp is defined as the inverse conjugate of lowerStarComp; consequently, the pullback comparison composition square is the transpose of the proved pushforward square. Evaluate at N and cancel the comparison isomorphisms to get the displayed equality.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15; ordinary coefficient change, proved via the canonical constructions and Mathlib adjunction mates
proof_origin.note: D4 second reader proved the full generalized composition equation from the proved one-map mate identity and pushforward composition. No admitted theorem remains.

lean.statement:
theorem comapUpperStarIso_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ' Z)) :
    (upperStarComp Λ f g).hom.app ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap a Z)).obj N) =
      (comapUpperStarIso a (f ≫ g)).inv.app N ≫
        (Mod.comap (coefficientMap a X)).map
          ((upperStarComp Λ' f g).hom.app N) ≫
        (comapUpperStarIso a f).hom.app ((g)^*⟦Λ'⟧.obj N) ≫
        (f)^*⟦Λ⟧.map ((comapUpperStarIso a g).hom.app N)
